title: Barbershop
description:
S1 E1
Calvin, who inherited a struggling barbershop, views the shop as nothing but a burden and waste of his time. After selling the shop to a local loan shark, Calvin slowly begins to see his father's vision and legacy .

title: Barbershop 2: Back in Business
description:
S1 E1 — Barbershop 2: Back in Business (2004)
The Barbershop is threatened by the arrival of a hip, well-financed chain barbershop that's about to open next door.

title: Barbershop: The Next Cut
description:
S1 E1
It's been more than 10 years since our last appointment at Calvin's Barbershop. Ice Cube, Cedric the Entertainer and the whole crew are back together for a quick trim, some good conversation, a little gossip...and to save their neighborhood!

title: Beauty Shop (2005)
description:
S1 E1
Gina is a long way from the Barbershop - she's moved from Chicago to Atlanta and buys a rundown salon and inherits a motley group of stylists and a colorful clientele. It's a rocky road to fulfilling her dreams, but you can't keep a good woman down!

title: Think Like a Man
description:
S1 E1
Four friends conspire to turn the tables on their women when they discover the ladies have been using Steve Harvey's relationship advice against them.

title: The Wood
description:
S1 E1
Lots of guys have second thoughts about marriage. Three hours before his wedding, Roland is having third, fourth and fifth thoughts. Good thing he’s got buddies Slim and Mike around to help.
